[SWS_CM_10248] Odd UTF-16LE and UTF-16BE string length
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
In case of UTF-16LE and UTF-16BE strings having an odd length, after removal of
the last byte, the two bytes before shall be 0x00 bytes (termination) for a string to be
valid.
⌋
